name: Telecom Egypt Manti (Ramses Exchange) data center
notes: Telco exchange/data center at 26 Ramsis, Shubra Al Khayma, Qalyubia Governorate, listed by Inflect with colocation/connectivity and CAIX peering presence; some listings attribute the Ramses Exchange to Cairo, so Qalyubia/Cairo boundary aliasing applies per EG methodology. Aggregate directory sources only; no NTRA licensee PDF or Telecom Egypt facility page naming this site was found in this pass, so grade stays C.

name: Telecom Egypt West Qena Data Center
notes: Regional telecom data center in Qena Governorate, Upper Egypt; Datacenters.com cites Telecom Egypt's list of eight protected data-center sites and DT-Holding lists West Qena among eight Telecom Egypt data centers using HI-FOG water mist fire suppression. Edge/telco facility; no public power or rack figures.

name: Matrouh Smart Government Services Complex data center component
notes: State Information Service reported the prime minister reviewed a proposed smart government services complex near the Olympic Village in Marsa Matrouh, including a data center covering base maps and regional layers. Government facility, not commercial colocation; MW not disclosed.

name: New Alamein City COC Data Centre (Giza Systems)
developer: New Alamein City Authority; Giza Systems (EPC)
notes: Giza Systems awarded the Command Operations Control (COC) Data Centre project by the New Alamein City Authority, located at the Authority's premises; project part of Egypt Vision 2030 smart-city buildout, reported completion within a year of the November 2024 award. Final operating status not independently confirmed; treat as under construction/commissioning.

name: West Port Said Free Zone data center
developer: West Port Said Free Zone / WAVZ for Digital Transformation
notes: WAVZ states it manages the data center of West Port Said Free Zone as part of the free-zone digital infrastructure development project; WAVZ-SCZone collaboration (Dec 2023 press release) underpins the free-zone digital transformation programme. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Telecom Egypt Sohag East Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists Telecom Egypt's Sohag East Data Center at Labor Bureau - Sohag East; aggregate directory source, no power/space data disclosed. Edge/telco facility lead.

name: Qareeb Data Centres Egypt Data Center - Gerga
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Qareeb Data Centres Egypt Data Center in Gerga, Sohag (part of Qareeb's regional edge platform); exact operating status, city verification and MW allocation not confirmed in public primary materials.

name: Kemet Data Center - Sokhna Industrial Zone / SCZONE
developer: INTRO Technology (INTRO Group) / Advansys; Oman Data Park
notes: $450M MoU (Sep 2024) between INTRO Technology and Oman Data Park for Kemet Data Center on an 80,000 sqm site in SCZONE Sokhna Industrial Zone, targeting cloud service export; later cabinet-linked reporting (Nov 2024) says SCZONE signed a land usufruct agreement with Intro Group, with the campus planned in phases and full completion targeted by end-2030 (80 MW total target). DataCenterMap also lists it. Planned; no construction/operational confirmation.

name: Government Data and Cloud Computing Center (P1) - Ain Sokhna
notes: President El-Sisi inaugurated the Government Data and Cloud Computing Center in Ain Sokhna (Suez Governorate); DCD reports it spans over 23,500 sqm with 10,000 sqm housing current infrastructure and the remainder reserved for expansion. MW not disclosed; government/sovereign facility.
